issues.concern: The semantic tag 'food-drink' is too narrow for the headword '薄皮' (usukawa), which can refer to any thin skin or membrane, not just those related to food. Example 2 demonstrates a non-food usage.
issues.suggestion: Replace 'food-drink' with 'general' or 'body-part' (if referring to human/animal skin/membrane) or 'nature' (if referring to plant skin/membrane).
